note: Both sets extract many correct claims regarding the louver shape, bend angle, solar altitude, and window azimuth. However, both sets struggle significantly with the formulas provided in the text, frequently misquoting the height formula by omitting parts of it, or incorrectly assigning 'D*1.2' to the depth-to-height ratio instead of height. Both also incorrectly attach the condition 'average' to the structural bend angle due to a misreading of the sentence boundary.
